μαθητής.shortDefinition: a disciple, pupil; lit. a learner

μαθήτρια.shortDefinition: a female disciple, pupil; lit. a female learner

μαρτύρομαι.shortDefinition: to call to witness; fig. to protest

ματαιόω.shortDefinition: to behave vainly, pointlessly, with futility

Μεσίας.shortDefinition: the Messiah; lit. an anointed person/thing; fig. an appointed person/thing

μέσος.shortDefinition: to be in the middle/midst of

μεταλαμβάνω.shortDefinition: to take with; fig. to partake

μετανοέω.shortDefinition: to change one’s understanding; fig. to repent

μετάνοια.shortDefinition: a changed understanding; fig. a repentance

μνεία.shortDefinition: a remembrance; fig. a mention, memory

μύριοι.shortDefinition: to be ten thousand; fig. to be innumerable

Μωσῆς.shortDefinition: Moses; lit. Drawing Out; fig. Rescued
